name: gaming-windows-client
description: Windows client and its approved backend interactions; optional REA artifact-analysis adapter.
objectives: Assess updater signature validation, rollback and downgrade behavior, local credential storage, IPC, DLL loading, local privilege boundaries, and backend authorization.
Exercise adversarial inputs and chained client-to-service abuse cases in a disposable Windows VM.
Correlate binary-analysis evidence with approved API and device-licensing targets.
operational_constraints: Use a disposable Windows VM, synthetic identities, and a test build.
Keep REA optional; network and API assessment works without a compiled-binary adapter.
